title: Dependabot's version updates wait a week, and SWERepo's settings turn auto-merge off
assertion: In what `swerepo init --only github` writes, for a uv project and a pip project alike and in solo and team mode: `.github/dependabot.yml` holds under `updates:` only two entries, one for `github-actions` and one for the project's Python ecosystem (`uv` with a `uv.lock`, else `pip`), with nothing after the last entry. Each entry has exactly one `cooldown:`, holding `default-days: 7` and nothing else (no shorter wait for some updates, no exclusions), so Dependabot proposes a version update only once the new version is a week old. `.github/swerepo/repo-settings.json` has `"allow_auto_merge": false`.

origin.text: The owner's decision (2026-11-23, ADR-20261123-cc8d): Dependabot's pull requests no longer wait for Copilot, so what guards them is a week's cooldown (a broken or malicious release is usually pulled by then) and a person who merges (auto-merge off, ADR-20261123-4e40 point 4). Locked at the owner's request, as its own rule. Tightened after SeamSpec's reviewer: the cooldown block holds only the 7 days, nothing follows the last entry, and the rule promises only what the written files hold.
